text_to_image_prompt:
Feminine athletic expedition guide. Dark sandy blond layered shoulder-length shag with swept side part, golden olive eyes, firm softly squared jaw, straight brows, warm ivory skin. Dark olive field jacket over black modest crewneck, understated woven backpack straps, original generic buckles, no weapon or text. Determined but friendly expression.

Create one fictional adult in premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D CG rendering, detailed individually resolved hair strands, natural delicate skin texture and crisp clothing and ornament materials. A landscape 1536x1024, 3:2 close-up head-and-upper-shoulders turnaround sheet. Three equal-width views in one horizontal row: LEFT true straight-on FRONT view with direct gaze, CENTER exact 90-degree PROFILE facing image-left, RIGHT exact 180-degree BACK view with no face visible. Same identity, hairstyle, clothing and accessory locations across all views. Camera at eye height, level upright head, neutral closed lips, matching head scale and crown levels, complete crown in frame. Pure opaque white background, soft even neutral studio lighting, natural cranial proportions. No text, labels, borders, watermarks, extra people, hands or full body.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a precise close-up HEAD TURNAROUND SHEET of the SAME single adult character in the supplied approved portrait. Landscape 3:2 canvas, target 1536x1024. Three equal-width panels in ONE horizontal row on seamless opaque pure WHITE #FFFFFF, no borders or text. LEFT: exact straight-on FRONT view looking directly into camera, zero yaw/pitch/roll. CENTER: exact 90-degree SIDE PROFILE facing viewer-left, nose points LEFT, only the near eye visible, no three-quarter angle. RIGHT: exact 180-degree BACK view of head and neck, NO face visible, shoulders turned away. All three are the same person rotated on a turntable, identical head scale, same eye-height camera, level head, matching crown/chin/shoulder heights. Tight head-and-neck portrait crop with tops of shoulders only; keep complete crown, hairstyle, ears and head accessories inside each panel with white margin; no full torso, no full body, no hands. Preserve EXACT facial identity, natural skull and face proportions, age, skin tone, eyes, nose, lips, jaw, hair color/style, headband/ornaments/jewelry and clothing neckline from reference. Neutral closed lips. Side and rear views must reconstruct coherent plausible anatomy and hairstyle continuous with the front, retaining location of asymmetric accessories, never duplicate or mirror accessories. Keep original premium semi-realistic 3D CG rendering, fine hair strands and delicate skin texture. Soft even neutral studio lighting across all views. No new design, no beautification, no face elongation, no watermarks, labels or extra objects.
